concept: Trying something new, even if you might not be good at it right away
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character hesitates to try something new out of fear of being bad at it, then tries anyway
exercise.reflection_prompt: What helped the character decide to try, even though it felt risky?
exercise.practice: Student names one new thing they'd like to try, even if they might not be great at it right away

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific new thing they're willing to try, not just a general statement
